text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: continuous-batching service SLO breach detected on region-us-west-2 at 2026-03-14T21:04:38Z. Error spike: 500s and token latency > 5s p99. Auto-page to #eng-oncall.

alex: I’m on it. Seeing a sharp increase in KV cache evictions and queue length. Likely a prefetched-KV blowup under high concurrency.

mira: Confirmed. Grafana: cb_inflight_queue_length jumped from ~30 -> 1.8k in 60s. microbatch_size hist shifted to 1-2 tokens for many requests (jitter).

sam: Any customer-facing 500s? Jordan?

jordan: Support: multiple customers reported elevated error rates and timeouts, some realtime chat integrations degraded. No big enterprise SLA hits reported yet but several webhooks retried.

tao: Are any recent rollouts for continuous-batching config? I have a rolling change that adjusted prefetch_window and adaptive_batching threshold yesterday.

mira: Yeah that rollout landed to 70% at 02:10 UTC. Looks correlated. Prefetch window increase + adaptive batching ramp probably combined to create KV pressure.

alex: Immediate mitigation: disable prefetch for the affected pool and cap microbatch size. Can one of you apply quick hotfix to the controller?

lee: I can patch controller flags. Proposed override: \n```\ncontinuous_batching.enabled: true\ncontinuous_batching.prefetch_window: 0  # disable prefetch\ncontinuous_batching.microbatch_max_tokens: 8\nkv_cache.max_entries: 200000\n```\nApply to pool "cb-pool-3" first as canary.

sam: +1. Also temporarily lower concurrency target for the pool to shed load: desired_replicas-> current_replicas * 0.6.

tao: Pushing canary override now to cb-pool-3. command: `rctl apply --pool cb-pool-3 --override cb-hotfix-3912345678`

incident-bot: Deploy kicked off: cb-pool-3 override -> 3/3 nodes updated.

mira: Telemetry: eviction rate dropped 80% after override, inflight queue length falling. p95 latency trending down.

alex: Good. Roll to remaining pools with throttled rate: 1 pool / 2 min. Sam, coordinate replica scaling change during roll.

sam: On it. I'll reduce target_concurrency on cb-pool-4 and cb-pool-5 now.

jordan: Noting customers impacted: cust-A (low volume) saw retries; cust-B (interactive chat) had increased latency. CS is sending hold message.

kate: Product: can we confirm if any features (tool-calls / streaming) were impacted differently? Need to notify downstream owners.

mira: Streaming sessions had more tail latency but not as many 500s. Synchronous batch generation saw most 500s when microbatch jitter pushed cache misses causing spikes.

lee: Finished rolling overrides to remaining pools. Commands used: `rctl rollout --label cb-hotfix-3912345678 --rate 1/2m`.

incident-bot: Rollout summary: 6 pools targeted, 6/6 applied (canary success).

alex: Actions to follow:
- revert yesterday’s prefetched-window increase in config PR (assign mira).
- add safeguard: if kv_cache_eviction_rate > 100/s for >1m, automatically disable prefetch and reduce microbatch window (tao).
- run postmortem and release notes (kate + alex).

mira: I'll open the rollback PR now, linking metrics and the exact commit.

tao: I'll add an automatic circuit-breaker in the controller by EOD. Patching policy: `if kv_evictions_per_min > 600 then prefetch_window=0, microbatch_max_tokens=8`

jordan: CS: sending update to affected customers now, will flag any escalations.

alex: Any residual risk?

lee: One oddity: some nodes showed near-zero KV cache hit ratio for a short window before eviction spike — suspect racing prefetch + microbatch under load created thundering KV fetch pattern. Will add tracing.

sam: I’ll keep monitoring for 30m and stand by for pager. If we see queue re-acceleration we’ll revert continuous-batching to baseline (disable cb) for the hottest routes.

kate: Postmortem owner assigned: kate (prod) + mira (eng-runtime). Draft due in 72 hours. Add impact timeline and customer list.

alex: Thanks everyone. Handing off to night on-call: sam, you're primary. I’ll be on standby.

sam: Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/CB/continuous-batching-overview

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared at 2026-03-14T21:23:40Z.

alex: Closing notes: hotfix avoided rollbacks, customer impact limited. Need longer-term: refine prefetch heuristics, limit microbatch jitter, and add KV backpressure to kernel.

mira: Will include kernel-level backpressure proposal in postmortem.

jordan: CS will follow up with a detailed customer-impact email tomorrow morning.

sam: I'll do one more check in 15m then mark resolved.
